@commonCancel.description: Closes a dialog or question without doing anything.

@refsCleanUp.description: A button: lists the branches that can be deleted.

@refsName.description: The field for a new remote's name.

@refsOnBranch.description: After a branch's name: the branch it is stacked on.

@refsTagKindLightweight.description: A column of the tag list: the kind of tag.

refsDeleteBranchesMessage: Each is backed up first; Undo brings it back.

@refsPull.description: A verb: the menu button of the ways to pull.

remoteCheckoutAhead: {count, plural, one {{name} is # commit ahead of {remote}, not pushed.} other {{name} is # commits ahead of {remote}, not pushed.}}

mergeBinaryBothSides: Binary file changed on both sides

mergeWillConflict: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} will conflict

@mergeTakeOursFor.description: A menu item; what is "File" or "3 Files".

compareNotSameKind: {old} and {new} are not both files or both folders

compareFirstFilesDiffer: The first {count, plural, one {# file differs} other {# files differ}}

@compareFileLabel.description: Accessibility label of a differing file; status is a word such as Added or Modified.

compareChooseFile: Choose a file to see its changes
